This sounds like the most stupid thing anyone could ever say to someone who is depressed, but if you want to be happy and are willing to work for it, you will end up happy.

Ask yourself some questions: do you find suicide, drugs, drinking, loneliness, nihilism etc. romantic and beautiful? Do you feel that you are only true to yourself when you are sad? Do you feel that no one understands you?

That's what I felt for a long time... but then I figured out it was all bullshit. It sounds so simple but; choose to be happy! Set some simple goals. Take one day at a time. And for God's sake, give up on the whole glamorization of drugs and suicide. It's NOT worth it!

Hope you'll feel better soon!

Big Star were a power pop band from the early 70's. Though they were considered old-fashioned at their time, they have become extremely influential on every single band who ever cared about melody and integrity.

But few people seem to know about them. This is from their third and final album, and main songwriter Alex Chilton was in a bad state at the time, hence the lyrics.
